notes: The C course now goes from beginner to professional: 82 lessons, targeting C23 with GCC 16.
New deep dives: C23 features, dates and times, and bounded strings done right.
New advanced lessons: a mini shell with pipes, signals, sockets, sanitizers and Valgrind hands on, secure coding, and the ABI and calling C from other languages.
New "Working like a pro" unit: make, modules and opaque types, static analysis, CI matrices, getopt_long tools, and shipping shared libraries.
Every C exercise now has wrong answers its tests reject, every lesson a Common mistakes note, and the capstones milestones.
